name: Rhede (Westfalen, Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Rhede (quartered green and white with zigzag bars and leaves).
history: By deed of the Bezirksregierung Münster of 23 September 1975 the city was granted the right to bear a flag and a banner; the hoisted flag is striped green, white and green in three stripes in the ratio 1:3:1 with the arms.

features.role: Rhede arms — quartered with zigzag bars and leaves
